description: List the current user's own individual time entries for a date range, with project name, task/subtask ids, hours, description, billable flag and status. Use this to see exactly what was logged (the per-entry detail), as opposed to aggregated totals.

end_date.description: End date of the range (ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-01-31)

limit.description: Optional maximum number of entries to return (1-200, default 200). Entries are returned most-recent first.

start_date.description: Start date of the range (ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-01-01)

name: list_my_time_entries
